goal: Speed up wallet fast rescans by checking compact block filters in parallel across multiple CPU cores
Saves users minutes when restoring wallets or rescanning large block ranges on multi-core systems
agreement: Substantive support across multiple benchmarks confirming major speedups and all concerns resolved
Verified 4.5x to 6x speedup across multi-core benchmarks (ismaelsadeeq)
Confirmed a 3x speedup even on an HDD setup (l0rinc)
Strong Concept ACK after concerns about threadpool isolation were resolved (rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it speeds up wallet fast rescans by roughly 4.5x to 8x on multi-core systems
Reduces rescan times across hundreds of thousands of blocks from several minutes down to tens of seconds
Directly improves wallet restoration and descriptor rescan latency for users
